items.title: Mrs. Francis Oliver Interview, 1969-05-10
items.q: I know him, Al Rose, he's a friend of mine, too.

ctx.x: Yes. And still has the music in the catalog. And not a, Mel, Mr. Mr. Melrose, there was somebody by the name of Rose, the man was named Rose himself, I think, that contacted us one day to take us out to dinner.
Oh, lovely. I know him, Al Rose, he's a friend of mine, too. Yes, yes. He took us out. He was written some things on the—

He took us out to dinner, and my brother took me to an exclusive store and had me a fitted pursuit for me to come home with. He was very nice to me. And really and truly, I couldn't thank him enough for sending us things, but let alone asking him—I wouldn't ask him for anything. I never have written him a letter yet, asking for anything. Yes. And he was so pleased with me when I married Dr. Oliver. He really was pleased with me. I told him I had met him, and he was a graduate from Harris Medical School, and that…
